title: Lab 2B — EventBridge schedule
topic: EventBridge schedule rules, ECS RunTask target, IAM trust for events.amazonaws.com, CloudWatch FailedInvocations
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-12-eventbridge-schedule.md and night-12-lab-eventbridge-schedule.sh. Answer without peeking at night-12-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Global Ski Atlas runs the Iceland OSM pipeline monthly as a one-shot Fargate task in private subnets — no HTTP endpoint. Night 10 proved manual ecs:RunTask works. What is the best way to trigger it on the 1st of each month without a always-on EC2 instance?

options.A: Application Load Balancer health check that calls RunTask
options.B: EventBridge schedule rule with an ECS cluster target and cron expression
options.D: CloudFront origin request trigger on the S3 output bucket

questions.question: You create an EventBridge rule targeting ecs:RunTask on cluster globalskiatlas-backend-k8s. The rule shows FailedInvocations in CloudWatch. The task definition and cluster names are correct. What is the most common IAM fix?

options.A: Attach AmazonEC2FullAccess to the default bus
options.B: Grant the EventBridge rule permission to assume the task role directly
options.C: Add a target IAM role trusted by events.amazonaws.com with ecs:RunTask and iam:PassRole on the execution and task roles
options.D: Move the rule to a custom event bus named ecs.amazonaws.com

questions.question: night-12-lab-eventbridge-schedule.sh sets AssignPublicIp to DISABLED and passes private subnet IDs from night-9-vpc-ids.json. Why must the EventBridge ECS target include the same networkConfiguration as Night 10 manual RunTask?

options.A: Scheduled RunTask still creates an awsvpc ENI — without subnets/SG the task cannot pull from ECR or reach S3
options.B: EventBridge always launches tasks in the default VPC public subnet unless overridden
options.C: AssignPublicIp ENABLED is required for EventBridge-triggered tasks only
options.D: The schedule expression must match the subnet CIDR block

questions.question: Which schedule expression runs the Iceland pipeline at 06:00 UTC on the first day of every month?
GitHub Actions already has ecs:RunTask and iam:PassRole for Iceland. After adding EventBridge, why can the rule not reuse the GitHub Actions IAM user credentials?

options.A: EventBridge invokes targets by assuming a dedicated IAM role attached to the rule target — not CI user keys
options.B: Fargate rejects tasks started by human IAM users
options.C: PassRole is only valid for Lambda targets
options.D: GitHub Actions credentials expire every 15 minutes

questions.question: An exam question describes decoupling microservices so a spike in orders does not overwhelm the inventory API. The inventory team wants to process at their own pace with at-least-once delivery. Which service fits better than an EventBridge schedule rule?

options.C: Amazon SQS standard queue between producer and consumer

questions.question: CloudWatch alarm saa-study-gsa-iceland-task-failed watches FailedInvocations on the EventBridge rule. The alarm fires. Invocations metric is zero. What most likely happened?

options.A: The container exited with code 1 after starting successfully
options.D: EventBridge could not invoke the ECS target (IAM, permissions, or invalid target config) before a task was created

questions.question: What is the trust policy principal for the IAM role used by an EventBridge rule that calls ecs:RunTask?

options.D: scheduler.amazonaws.com only — classic EventBridge rules cannot assume roles

questions.question: You need a one-time reminder to run a migration at 2026-07-01 03:00 UTC with flexible delivery within a 15-minute window and automatic retries. Which option is most purpose-built?

options.D: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler schedule with flexible time window

questions.question: The Iceland pipeline is batch ETL, not a long-running web service. Which statement about load balancers is correct for Night 12?

options.A: An internal ALB is required so EventBridge can health-check the task
options.B: Network Load Balancer must front Fargate for EventBridge triggers
options.C: No load balancer is needed — RunTask starts the task directly; ALB applies when exposing HTTP services
options.D: Gateway Load Balancer inspects scheduled ECS tasks by default

questions.question: eventbridge-ecs-run-policy.json scopes ecs:RunTask with a Condition on ecs:cluster. Why scope to cluster globalskiatlas-backend-k8s?

options.A: Fargate tasks can only run in one cluster per account
options.B: Least privilege — the role should not start arbitrary tasks on other clusters
options.C: EventBridge ignores RunTask unless the cluster name matches the rule name
options.D: PassRole requires identical cluster and role names

questions.question: A rule on the default event bus matches {"source":["aws.ecs"],"detail-type":["ECS Task State Change"]}. What type of rule is this compared to the Iceland monthly pipeline rule?

options.A: Schedule expression rule — same as cron(0 6 1 * ? *)
options.B: API destination rule — calls an external HTTPS endpoint
options.D: Event pattern rule — reacts to AWS service events, not a fixed timetable

questions.question: For immediate lab validation you run night-12-lab-eventbridge-schedule.sh --test-fire (temporary rate(1 minute)). After success you restore cron(0 6 1 * ? *). What cost should you expect compared to leaving rate(1 minute) enabled?

options.A: Identical — schedule expression does not affect Fargate cost
options.B: Higher — cron rules incur per-invocation charges that rate rules do not
options.C: Lower — monthly cron runs the expensive Fargate task roughly once per month instead of every minute
options.D: Zero in both cases — Fargate is free for EventBridge triggers

questions.question: Which iam:PassRole condition key should appear when EventBridge passes globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-ecs-execution to ECS?

options.D: No condition — PassRole cannot be constrained

questions.question: Night 13 will add SQS so the pipeline publishes a completion message instead of chaining synchronously. How does that differ from Night 12 EventBridge → RunTask?

options.A: SQS replaces the need for ECS entirely
options.B: EventBridge starts the batch job on a schedule; SQS buffers events/messages between decoupled producers and consumers
options.C: EventBridge cannot target ECS if SQS exists in the same account
options.D: SQS only works with API Gateway WebSocket APIs
